sonnet.problem: This card asks again about the line 'This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.' Stop 1 card 6 already asked about that line when it first appeared in 9:3, and Stop 1 card 10 retold it from 9:6. Its right answer, that the LORD anointed him king over Israel, re-uses the answer already shown on card 6 and re-asks the same fact.
sonnet.rule: When a line repeats in the passage, like a psalm's refrain, ask about it only the first time it appears in this passage. ... An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. ... An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
